skills.name: follow-up-email
skills.description: Use after a call or meeting to draft a follow-up email that recaps decisions and asks for one clear next step.

skills.name: incident-writeup
skills.description: Use after something broke to write a blameless incident summary: timeline, impact, cause, and follow-ups.

skills.name: investor-update
skills.description: Use monthly to draft an investor update from closed issues, goals, metrics the owner shared, and asks.

skills.name: meeting-prep
skills.description: Use before an external meeting to prepare a one-page brief: who they are professionally, history with them, talking points and questions.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Use to review a pull request: what changed, risks, missing tests, and a clear verdict.

skills.name: weekly-review
skills.description: Use on Friday afternoon or Monday morning to review the week: closed work, goal progress, slipped commitments and next week's top three priorities.
